_doc: Vibe Auth — single sign-on for the Vibe product family (bundled authentik + broker). Vendored from KisaesDevLab/Vibe-Auth deploy/. Installed ONLY when the firm selects it (console toggle or `vibe enable vibe-auth`); products stay on local sign-in until flipped (D11). Routing: the broker is path-mounted at /vibe-auth/ like every other app; authentik is a `routing.mounts` entry at /auth (served with AUTHENTIK_WEB__PATH=/auth/, so no prefix stripping) — this replaces the original :8443 port design (COMPAT.md amendment 4, QUESTIONS Q7). routing.stripPrefix=false: the broker serves every route under VIBE_AUTH_BASE_PATH (/vibe-auth/setup, /vibe-auth/admin, /vibe-auth/health), so Caddy must pass the prefix through; only /health and /version have bare aliases.
description: Single sign-on for firm staff across Vibe products (bundled authentik, MFA enforced, Entra ID / Google federation).
emergencyNote: Emergency access reaches the broker's console only; single sign-on itself needs the Caddy route (/auth/) and cannot run over the emergency port.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for the sign-in service's host label. Empty = the built-in default (auth), with the appliance Hostname tag applied. Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress) when DOMAIN_ROUTING_MODE=subdomain-per-app; ignored in single-host mode. Needs broker 1.0.9 or newer: older brokers assume the label is exactly 'auth'. Single DNS label — lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> for the sign-in service when routing is 'subdomain per app'. Leave blank for the default (auth, plus the hostname tag if one is set). Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes; no dots. Saving re-renders routing, re-registers every app's sign-in address and re-provisions the Cloudflare Tunnel; apps briefly restart.

optional.name: VIBE_AUTH_BRAND_NAME
optional.doc: Firm name shown on the sign-in page and as the SSO button label in products. The setup wizard sets it too.

optional.name: VIBE_AUTH_MFA_REQUIRED
optional.doc: true (default) enforces MFA for every sign-in. The Vibe Auth admin console can switch it off with a logged acknowledgement (D23).

optional.name: VIBE_AUTH_SMTP_HOST
optional.doc: SMTP host for password-recovery emails. Inherited from the appliance Email settings.

optional.name: VIBE_AUTH_SENTINEL_URL
optional.doc: Sentinel audit-ingest endpoint (POST). Empty = audit events stay in Postgres + /data/audit.jsonl only.

firstLogin.note: First visit runs a setup wizard gated by a one-time token. The console's Identity panel shows the link and token (also printed to the broker log: docker logs vibe-auth). The wizard creates the firm's first identity administrator; no default password exists (D13).
